questions.question: Dr. Sofia, now a national reference for women dentists, is invited to an international congress. What message should she carry?
options: Women are a model of resilience and excellence
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia explains: 'Women are a model of resilience and excellence.' Meriem: 'I am proud of you.'

questions.question: Dr. Meriem must create a foundation to promote women dentists. What is the main objective?
questions.explanation: Dr. Meriem explains: 'Promoting women's leadership is essential for the future.' Dr. Sofia: 'I will support this foundation.'

questions.question: Dr. Sofia must write a reference book on women dentists. What is the central message?
options: Women are an art that combines professionalism and sensitivity
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia explains: 'Women are an art that combines professionalism and sensitivity.' Meriem: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Meriem must give a closing speech at an international congress. What note should she leave?
options: Women dentists are the future of the profession
questions.explanation: Dr. Meriem explains: 'Women dentists are the future of the profession.' Dr. Sofia: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Sofia must create a mentoring program for women dentists. What is the main objective?
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia explains: 'Mentoring transmits fundamental skills.' Meriem: 'I will support this program.'

questions.question: Dr. Meriem must manage the succession of her commitment to women. What is the best strategy?
questions.explanation: Dr. Meriem explains: 'Gradual preparation of transmission is the key to a successful succession.' Dr. Sofia: 'I will help you.'

questions.question: Dr. Sofia must create a charter for supporting women. What is the fundamental pillar?
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia explains: 'Solidarity and women's empowerment are the pillars of any support charter.' Meriem: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Meriem must train future mentors. What is the first message to convey?
options: Mentoring is a mission of support and transmission
Mentoring is a source of income
questions.explanation: Dr. Meriem explains: 'Mentoring is a mission of support and transmission.' Dr. Sofia: 'I will convey this message.'

questions.question: Dr. Sofia must prepare a testimony on her mentoring journey. What is the most striking element?
options: The joy of seeing women succeed
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia explains: 'The joy of seeing women succeed is the most striking element.' Meriem: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Meriem must create an association of former mentors. What is the main objective?
options: Maintain the link and foster mutual support
questions.explanation: Dr. Meriem explains: 'Mutual support and the link are the driving forces of an association of former mentors.' Dr. Sofia: 'I will support this association.'

questions.question: Dr. Sofia must write an article on the future of women dentists. What trend should be highlighted?
options: The decline of women in the profession
The decrease in demand for women dentists
The disappearance of women in the profession
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia explains: 'The importance of women's leadership is a promising trend.' Meriem: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Meriem must create a quality label for supporting women. What are the main criteria?
questions.explanation: Dr. Meriem explains: 'Quality of support and mentoring are the fundamental criteria.' Dr. Sofia: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Sofia must give a farewell speech to the profession. What message should she leave?
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia explains: 'The profession needs passionate women.' Meriem: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Meriem must create an award for women dentists. What is the purpose?
questions.explanation: Dr. Meriem explains: 'Stimulating women's excellence is the driving force of the profession's evolution.' Dr. Sofia: 'I will support this award.'

questions.question: Dr. Sofia must write her memoirs. What is the common thread to highlight?
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia explains: 'The passion for supporting women is the common thread of a professional life.' Meriem: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Meriem must create a training center for women dentists. What is the vision?
questions.explanation: Dr. Meriem explains: 'Training must produce leaders and mentors.' Dr. Sofia: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Sofia must leave a legacy to the profession. What is the most beautiful legacy?
options: Mentoring skills and an example to follow
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia explains: 'Mentoring skills and an example to follow are the most beautiful legacy.' Meriem: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Meriem must write a letter to future women dentists. What message should she convey?
options: Dentistry is an exciting adventure for women
questions.explanation: Dr. Meriem explains: 'Dentistry is an exciting adventure for women.' Dr. Sofia: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Sofia must create a scholarship for women dentists. What is the main objective?
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia explains: 'Supporting deserving women is an investment for the future.' Meriem: 'I will support this initiative.'

questions.question: Dr. Meriem must give a closing speech. What note should she leave?
questions.explanation: Dr. Meriem explains: 'Women dentists continue to inspire.' Dr. Sofia: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Sofia must pass on her knowledge to women. What is the priority?
options: Sell her knowledge at the highest price
Transmit in the continuity of skills
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia explains: 'Transmission in the continuity of skills is the most beautiful success.' Meriem: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Meriem must create a peer network for women dentists. What is the objective?
options: Foster mutual support and experience sharing
questions.explanation: Dr. Meriem explains: 'Mutual support and sharing are essential for women dentists.' Dr. Sofia: 'I will support this network.'

questions.question: Dr. Sofia must write a conclusion to her book. What is the final sentence?
options: Women dentists are a magnificent human adventure
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia explains: 'Women dentists are a magnificent human adventure.' Meriem: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Meriem must leave a message to future generations. What is the message?
options: Dentistry is a discipline worth experiencing for women
Dentistry has no future for women
questions.explanation: Dr. Meriem explains: 'Dentistry is a discipline worth experiencing for women.' Dr. Sofia: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Sofia, after a life dedicated to supporting women, receives national recognition. Dr. Meriem is by her side. What is Sofia's message to young women?
options: Dentistry has no future for women
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia concludes: 'Dentistry needs passionate women to continue evolving.' Dr. Meriem: 'I am proud of you.'
